screens.title: A big week
paras: This week we have **Health and Safety inspections** on Wednesday night, the start of **Door Knock #2**, and a quick note about Office Hours. Stick around to the end for a shout-out.
Complete this Focus by 8:30 PM Wednesday. At the end you'll get a code to email to James.

check.q: Which two big things are on this week's plate?
options: Door Knock #2 and a building-wide fire drill run by the front desk
'Cuse Chat #2 kicks off and the floor meetings for spring
Health and Safety inspections and the start of Door Knock #2
The end of Door Knock #2 and a round of Office Hours make-ups

screens.title: Inspections: Wednesday at 8:30 PM
paras: We need every one of you with us for this, so please plan to be in our team meeting classroom at **8:30 PM** on **Wednesday, November 11**, with your **laptop**.
You'll need your laptop when we come back to the classroom afterward.

check.q: Where and when do we meet on Wednesday?

fields.label: Place
options: The lobby
The team meeting classroom
Your own floor
Flint 100I

screens.title: Your floor and your partner
paras: Same as last week, and nobody inspects their own floor.

options: James V. and Calysta
Max and Addy
Henry and Hannah
Mark and Giselle

screens.title: A quick refresher
paras: **Entering a room:** knock and announce twice ("RA, Health and Safety Inspections!"). Then say "RA, keying in" and, once the door is open, "RA, entering the room."
**Paper first.** Fill in your floor's printed roster for every room.
**Don't flag** curtains, fridges or shot glasses. For microwaves without auto shutoff, check the box but don't take them.

check.q: You find a microwave with no auto shutoff. What do you do?
options: Check the box on the form, but leave it in the room
Take it with you and tape a label on it with the room number
Skip it entirely, since microwaves aren't part of inspections
Unplug it and leave a note asking the resident to remove it

screens.title: Take photos of everything
paras: Take a photo of anything you notice, **even small things**. Photos document the issue, and they protect you.

check.q: You spot something minor. Do you still take a photo?
options: Only if you plan to confiscate it
Yes, because photos document the issue and protect you
No, photos are just for serious stuff
Only if your partner agrees it's worth it

screens.title: Back to the classroom: submit it all that night
paras: When your floor is done, come back to the classroom and submit everything **that night**:
A **Roompact form for every room**, issue or not.
An **incident report for real conduct violations**, like alcohol (photograph it, then dump it), drugs (call DPS first), and smoking or vaping.

check.q: You find a vape in a room. What do you submit?
options: A Roompact form only
An incident report only
Nothing, as long as you took a photo
A Roompact form and an incident report, both that night

screens.title: Next up: Door Knock #2 🛍️
paras: That's it for inspections. Thank you in advance for a smooth night!
The rest of this Focus is all about **Door Knock #2**: what's in the bags, how to pack them, and when to get it done.

check.q: What are the next few screens about?
options: More inspection rules
Spring duty scheduling
Door Knock #2: the bags, packing, and timing
Next week's meeting agenda

screens.title: Door Knock #2: Wellness Check-In
paras: This round is a lighter lift than the first one. You're stopping by with a little goody bag and asking **one question** to see how your residents are doing overall.

**Please start right away.** As soon as your bags are packed, start knocking and logging. With Thanksgiving break in the middle, we don't have much time, so please don't wait until after break to get going.

check.q: What makes Door Knock #2 a lighter lift than the first one?
options: You only knock on half your floor
You drop off a goody bag and ask just one question
You can do it all over text instead
There's no Roompact form afterward

screens.title: Pack your bags
paras: The supplies aren't in yet. When they arrive, James will send a group text, and they'll be on the big table in the resource room. Please come down and pack yours as soon as you can.
Pack **one bag per resident** on your floor:
list: Not the fanciest candy in the world, but 1,000 pieces adds up fast!
Cut one from the sheet on the table
after: Then put a sticker on the outside and tie it closed. Bring a tote or bag to carry them back to your room.

check.q: Which of these does NOT go inside the bag?
options: A star stress ball
A Wellness QR code cut from the sheet on the table
A mini fidget spinner
The sticker, which goes on the outside

screens.title: Done packing? Send the code word
paras: Once your bags are packed, text or email James **"Baggy Boogie"** so he knows you're all set.

check.q: What's the code word once your bags are packed?
options: Bag Boogie
Boogie Bags
Baggie Bonanza
Baggy Boogie

screens.title: Ask one question, your way
paras: Knock, chat and hand over the bag. Ask **one question**, in whatever way feels natural to you. If you'd like a starting point, here are a few from the Curriculum Team:

"How are your energy levels holding up as we head into the winter months?" · "What's the first thing you're going to do the second your last final is over?" · "What's something you've crossed off your to-do list this week that you're proud of?" · "What's something you can do to refill your tank through the last stretch of the semester?"
**You don't have to use these.** Ask it however you like.

check.q: How should you ask your one question?
options: However feels natural; the examples are just a starting point
Read one of the examples word for word, so it's consistent
Ask all four of the examples, in the same order every time
Hand the resident a short survey and collect it the next day

screens.title: Log it within 24 hours
paras: After each visit, log it in the **Door Knock #2** form in Roompact within 24 hours.

check.q: You knocked on a door Thursday at 7 PM. When should it be logged?
options: By Thursday at midnight
By Friday at 7 PM
Once your whole floor is finished
By the end of next week

screens.title: This week and next week are crunch time
paras: **Every resident needs to be reached by Wednesday, December 2.** No knocks over Thanksgiving break (November 20 to 29).
This week and next week are really our crunch time. That's when James would love to see the **vast majority** of your knocks logged, so that after Thanksgiving it's just a few stragglers.

check.q: When should most of your knocks be done?
options: Over Thanksgiving break, while the building is quiet and calm
The week after Thanksgiving, all at once before the deadline
Anytime at all, as long as it's done before finals end
This week and next week, before Thanksgiving

screens.title: The foam board
paras: The Wellness Challenge board lives in **Flint 100I** (the middle office, unlocked). The on-duty RA brings it in when they come on duty and sets it back out in the lobby the next morning.

check.q: You're on duty tonight. What do you do with the board?
options: Leave it in the lobby overnight; custodial takes care of it
Bring it to your own room for the night so it stays safe
Bring it into Flint 100I, then set it back out in the morning
Nothing at all; only James moves the board in and out

screens.title: Need a hand?
paras: As always, James is happy to help. If you're having trouble reaching people, or there's a resident you'd rather not knock on alone, just reach out and we'll figure it out together.

check.q: There's a resident you'd rather not knock on alone. What's the move?
options: Skip them for now; it's okay to miss one resident
Leave the bag outside their door with a note attached
Ask one of your other residents to go knock with you
Reach out to James, and we'll figure it out together

screens.title: Office Hours reflections 📝
paras: Check your inbox: James sent each of you a quick note Monday morning with your Office Hours count. You only need **one** reflection per week, even if you split your hours into two sessions. But we really do need that one reflection **every single week**, even when no residents stop by.
**We should have 10 in by the end of this week.** If you're not sure how many you have done, or which weeks you may still need to submit, please reach out to James. :)

check.q: You split your office hours into two sessions this week. How many reflections do you submit?
options: One
Two, one per session
None, if nobody stopped by
One for every hour you were there

screens.title: Next week's team meeting: the ZenDen 🧘
paras: On **Wednesday, November 18**, we're not meeting at our usual place. Instead, we're heading to **the ZenDen in Haven Hall** to try something new and give feedback on it. You'll be split into two groups:
list: Gabby, Jax, James V., Jazera, Mark, Michael, Tristan
Addy, Calysta, Giselle, Henry, Keira, Max, Rem, Stephanie
after: Hannah is excused, since she's on duty that night.
James tried to accommodate people who have class before our usual time, but please let him know if there are any issues with this. **This is still a mandatory team meeting.**

check.q: You're in Group 2. When do you go to the ZenDen?
options: 8:30 PM, our usual time

screens.title: 🥦 The Golden Broccoli Club!
paras: You know James loves a Golden award, but this one isn't his idea. Kim is starting the **Golden Broccoli Club** to recognize RAs who did an amazing job on 'Cuse Chats, and she's thrilled to announce that **FOURTEEN of you** will be inducted this month!
So proud of this team. 🎉

options: James's
The RA team's
Kim's
Residential Living's student board
